items.name: Delta Access expansion, Transco corridor
items.claim: As part of the Momentum Midstream acquisition, Williams' Delta Access expansion along the Transco corridor will serve growing LNG and power demand; the $1.5 billion project will provide initial capacity of 2.25 Bcf/d, with future expansion opportunities.
items.source_excerpt: The $1.5 billion project will provide initial capacity of 2.25 Bcf/d, with future expansion opportunities

items.name: Take-or-pay contract base underpinning Momentum Midstream acquisition
items.claim: Williams' agreed Momentum Midstream acquisition is underpinned by predictable, fee-based cash flows, supported by fixed-fee earnings, take-or-pay contracts and a high-quality customer base.
items.source_excerpt: Predictable, fee-based cash flows, supported by fixed-fee earnings, take-or-pay contracts and a high-quality customer base, underpin the transaction's long-term value.

notes: Q2 2026 8-K earnings release is the only stored evidence for Williams. It discloses a named, dollar-valued and capacity-quantified expansion project (Delta Access, $1.5 billion, 2.25 Bcf/d) plus the contract structure underpinning the concurrently announced Momentum Midstream acquisition; both are gas-supply-and-interconnection-relevant.
